Project governance proposals

Proposals for discussion, not an operating organization.

SuperUnicode is an experimental, developer-led open-source project. It has no consortium, formal membership program, elected body, committee system or registry authority today. The standard, the machine-instruction database and the reference implementation are maintained as project artifacts in the public repository.

The pages here describe possible future arrangements for participation and for handling allocation or registry proposals. They are not a description of current procedures, and nothing on them grants authority to approve changes or assign ranges. Any arrangement that is adopted will be documented here after it exists.
